changes.summary: Reconcile direct config edits during sync.
changes.body: Sync installs newly selected skills, removes deselected managed skills and lock entries, and preserves retained content hashes. Results report installed, unchanged and removed counts.

adoption.text: Edit skillbox/config.json and run sync. Both tracking files must already exist; use add for the first installation. Managed installed files are generated output and can be replaced or removed.

changes.summary: Bundle offline configuration and authoring guidance.
changes.body: Discover guidance with skills list, load instructions with skills get, retrieve supporting resources with skills file, and request response schemas with skills schema.
Migration guidance is manual; this does not add an automated migration command.

changes.summary: Expose the installed version with -v and --version.
Clarify source grouping, local bundles and npm execution options.
changes.body: Reuse the exact source string to merge bundle selections. Ignore generated .agents/skills/ and the .claude/skills symlink in consuming projects.
Store the SDK-format lock at skillbox/lock.json, preserve existing entries and workspace-relative source paths, and leave the root skills-lock.json owned by npx skills untouched.
breaking: Skillbox no longer reads its lock from the root skills-lock.json.

adoption.text: If Skillbox 0.1.0 created your root skills-lock.json, move it to skillbox/lock.json before upgrading. Do not move an unrelated npx skills lock; migration is not automatic.

changes.summary: Publish the repository-local skill bundle CLI under MIT.
changes.body: Install local or Git-hosted bundles with add, record source selections and SDK lock entries, and restore matching skill contents with sync. Includes workspace selection, JSON outcomes, a prebuilt npm CLI and a standalone binary. Lock hashes check content; immutable revision replay, shared caching, updates and patches are not implemented.
